_metadata.product_long_name: MODIS/Aqua Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m SIN Grid V061
_metadata.sampling: Point extraction at each district headquarters coordinate; native 250 m MODIS pixel.
_metadata.date_label_note: Dates are MODIS 16-day composite start dates as delivered by AppEEARS. The first and last composites can extend beyond the requested start/end because composites overlap those boundaries.
_metadata.qa_rule: pixel_reliability 0 (good) and 1 (marginal) are marked valid; 2 (snow/ice) and 3 (cloudy) are retained in the series with valid=false and excluded from latest_valid. Composite dates with no usable source value are listed as missing, never filled.
_metadata.units: NDVI, dimensionless (MODIS scale factor 0.0001 already applied by AppEEARS)
